summary: Software engineer building applied AI products with .NET, Angular, Python, and Azure. Experience in LLM orchestration, Model Context Protocol (MCP), hybrid tool retrieval, secure connectors, and production deployments.
hero: I build applied AI products with .NET, Angular, Python, and Azure—from LLM orchestration and MCP tools to secure connectors and Docker code execution.
about: My engineering career began in November 2023 at Unlock Future Fintech Pvt Ltd. I build .NET and Angular products and have handled company deployments for two years.
My AI work covers company copilot features, LLM orchestration, MCP tools, hybrid tool retrieval, and Python code execution. I also investigate tool failures and review model outputs.
I work with Linux, SSH, Docker, and Azure, alongside JWT, SSO, RBAC, VAPT remediation, and technical audit support.
availability: Open to remote Applied AI, LLM, agent engineering, and forward-deployed AI roles that accept candidates working from India. Also interested in AI-focused backend, full-stack, and developer tooling roles.
